title: Not touring and not cooperating with record companies
summary: He refused to travel because he disliked planes and ships and did not follow up records, so they never went far; Domino did cooperate.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters

blocks.x: Yeah, well they claimed all those Hatacols, claimed they'd do everything. Yeah. But, and on the Bald Head record, the Bald Head was the first, first song really that you were in the charts with, do you remember? Did you go out of town? Did you tour any off that record? No. I didn't. I just started leaving.
